status: supplemental development observation; does not replace original first-failure protocol
pilot: all 160 frozen pilot traces, 6528 steps; prior five compared steps re-executed only under this changed observation protocol
scale_budget: existing campaign phase, 512 traces per stratum per variant, horizon 256; choose smaller balanced prefix prospectively only if pilot resource projection fails
histories: Exact intent, binary32 reference and native C each retain their own state across the entire trace. At every step also call C on the current reference state for common-input comparison. Never replace either state after a discrepancy; only registered trace reset inputs reset it.
exact_coverage: Every executed step: exact stateful trajectory and exact local intent at reference state. Additional local exact intent at C state only if numerically different. Original bound recurrence remains unchanged.
classification_semantics: Signed zero is bit inequality with numerically equal state and equal flags. Common classes compare C and binary32 on reference state. Rollout classes compare their independently evolved histories. Branch requirement compares exact stateful flags to either rounded history. Numeric bound checks original local and stateful bounds. Categories may overlap; counts report steps and affected traces separately. Ordinary rounding is nonzero state error without bound violation.
continue_rule: Record finite admitted discrepancies and continue both histories and all independent traces. Nonfinite/out-of-domain output, invalid input or exception stops only the affected trace, records unclassified/generator-invalid, and continues others. Stop whole run only on resource ceiling or harness/oracle failure; preserve all outputs and resume trace-level checkpoint without dropping failed traces.
independent_oracle_audit: Before scale: exact nearest-even binary32 arithmetic reconstructed using Fraction and adjacent representable candidates, independently of NumPy. Audit every directed pilot step and each sixteenth random pilot step on recorded reference prior state. Preserve signed zero by operation sign. Compare complete tuple bits to existing reference. Closed-form exact intent checks remain separate.
scale_gate: Independent oracle audit passes and projected time (2x pilot per-step time) fits remaining allowance, with storage/RSS below caps. Representation and within-bound branch discrepancies are observations, not acceptance or human approval.
raw_evidence: Stream compressed per-step rows, full discrepancy index, per-trace summaries and first representative of each class externally. Report source/corpus/output hashes and per-mechanism counts. Shrink first representative of every encountered discrepancy class after execution without changing semantics.
cross_compiler: Use same original registered development traces in a standalone runner. Pin available isolated Linux image/compiler/QEMU; explicit user-mode execution and arithmetic controls. At most one CPU and 1 GiB VM memory; stop VM after use. No privileged host changes or global context changes.
not_authorized: reserved cases, wrapper qualification, integration/SITL, functional contract adoption, independent reviewer appointment, physical timing, claims of exhaustive coverage
